description: Archer-Daniels-Midland Company and its subsidiaries unlock the power of nature to enrich the quality of life, and are an essential global agricultural supply chain manager and processor that provides food security by connecting local needs with global capabilities, as well as a premier human and animal nutrition provider and a leader in health and well-being products. It partners with thousands of farmers around the world to purchase their crops and uses its integrated global origination, logistics and manufacturing network to transform many of those raw commodities into an expansive array of products serving the food, feed, fuel, and industrial and consumer products sectors, offering a broad portfolio of food and beverage products from staple foods to natural colors and flavors, plant-based proteins and lower-sugar, fat and salt solutions, plus nutrition ingredients and health and well-being products such as probiotics, enzymes and supplements.
